problem_statement: The bitmask utility library lacks a function to rotate a bitmask pattern forward (to the right) in place by a given number of bits. Bits at index i should move to position (i + bitShift) % bitLength, wrapping the trailing bits back to the start. Unused trailing bits in the last byte beyond the specified bit length should be cleared. The required interface is RotateBitmask(uint8_t *aMask, uint16_t aBitLength, uint16_t aBitShift).
